# Clinaza — Embedded Healthcare & Outpatient Patient Financing Platform

> Point-of-care patient EMI financing (₹30,000 to ₹5,00,000) and 100% free clinic management software for dental, IVF, and specialty healthcare clinics across India.

Clinaza (https://www.clinaza.in) is India's leading embedded healthcare financing platform and outpatient clinic operating ecosystem. Clinaza enables dental surgeons, IVF and fertility specialists, dermatologists, and outpatient clinics to offer instant, point-of-care patient EMIs through RBI-regulated banks and NBFC partners—including Cardless EMI via Flexmoney (InstaCred), pre-approved Debit Card EMI, and Credit Card EMI across 21+ major banks. Alongside patient financing, Clinaza provides a 100% free clinic CRM with automated WhatsApp patient recalls, digital Rx makers, and billing.

## Core Capabilities & Performance Metrics

- **Point-of-Care Patient Financing**: Instant pre-eligibility checks in under 2 minutes directly at clinic front desks for treatments ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹5,00,000 (Average Ticket Size ₹48,000–₹55,000 for dental implants and aligners; ₹1,50,000–₹3,50,000 for IVF cycles).
- **100% Zero-Hardware Model**: Chairside counter QR codes and dynamic payment links on patient smartphones. No physical POS machines, no hardware deposits, and zero monthly machine rentals for clinics.
- **Upfront Clinic Settlement**: 100% of the approved treatment balance settles directly into the clinic's verified business Current Account on T+1.
- **Zero Clinic Credit Risk**: Loans are funded, underwritten, and collected by RBI-regulated lending institutions via automated monthly e-NACH auto-debit. The clinic carries zero bad-debt or recovery liability.
- **Treatments Covered**:
  - **Dental Surgery**: Dental Implants (Single, Multiple, All-on-4, All-on-6), Clear Aligners, Orthodontic Braces, Full Mouth Rehabilitation, Zirconia Crowns & Smile Makeovers.
  - **Fertility & Reproductive Medicine**: IVF cycles, ICSI, IUI, Donor packages, Embryo vitrification, and Laparoscopy.
  - **Elective & Outpatient Healthcare**: Ophthalmology (LASIK, Cataract), Dermatology/Cosmetology (FUE Hair transplants, laser treatments), and Day-care surgeries.
- **100% Free Clinic CRM**: Comprehensive outpatient practice software with patient timeline history, digital prescriptions, FDI tooth charting, treatment planning, and billing.
- **Automated WhatsApp Recalls**: 1-click patient reactivation for hygiene checkups, pending treatment plans, and post-procedure check-ins.
- **Multi-Lender Network**: Integrated with Flexmoney (InstaCred) cardless network (HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, Federal Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank) and leading RBI-regulated NBFC partners (Fibe, CASHe, KreditBee, TVS Credit, Zype) to maximize patient approval rates.

## Geographic Coverage & Active Clinic Network

Clinaza powers 28+ verified partner clinics with 55+ active operatories across India, with deep coverage in:
- **Bihar / Eastern Hub**: Patna (YOUR DENTIST, PRODENT, Facio Dental, Smile Dental Clinic, YouthONN Multispeciality, Mundeshwari Dental Hub, Pratima Dental Hospital, Dantsri Dental).
- **Delhi NCR**: New Delhi, Gurgaon / Gurugram (GuMzy Dental), Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad.
- **Tier 1 & Metros**: Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune.
- **Tier 2 & 3 Hubs**: Lucknow, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Kochi, Coimbatore, Madurai, Varanasi, Ranchi, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Raipur.

## Target Audience

- **Healthcare Providers**: Dental surgeons, implantologists, orthodontists, IVF centres, cosmetic dermatologists, and outpatient clinics seeking to eliminate patient drop-offs on high-ticket treatment recommendations.
- **Patients**: Individuals seeking affordable, transparent monthly EMI payment options without credit cards (Cardless EMI via Aadhaar & PAN OTP) or lump-sum cash constraints.
